headline: Half-year Synthesis — 進歩の単位はModelからExecution Stackへ
deck: 2025年後半、model、agent execution、open deployment、multimodal/action space、runtime、controlは相互依存する技術stackとして観測されるようになった。

blocks.text: 7〜8月はagent、open-weight、frontier APIの主要layerが立ち上がり、9〜10月はcoding agent、tool/context、multimodal、runtimeが接続し、11〜12月はmodel family更新が加速する一方でcontrol hardeningが明示化した。modelが不要になったのではなく、model/API/product/runtimeのidentityを分けなければ実用能力とriskを説明できなくなった。2025年末にもavailability差、living index、project評価、runtime条件など未解決境界は残る。

must_cover_coverage.requirement: model/API/product/runtimeのidentity分離が必要になった理由
変わらなかった点・未解決点・coverage limitationを区別

boundary_coverage.requirement: Primary-source verification establishes the bounded facts recorded here; it does not convert vendor, project, or author evaluations into independent reproduction.

The preserved newsroom snapshot is a living paginated index and its first HTML page emphasized 2026 entries; item-level official Anthropic pages were followed during interactive verification to reconstruct H2 2025 chronology.
The changelog is a service/API chronology, not an upstream research-release chronology; preview-to-GA and shutdown events should not be merged with initial model announcements.
Benchmark and 'best' claims remain vendor-attributed; release, API availability, model identity, controls, and safety-method publication are primary facts.
Open weights do not imply an unrestricted data/training disclosure; openness should be described specifically in terms of weights/license and deployment.
The preserved DeepMind index snapshot is paginated and its first page is not a complete H2 archive; item-level first-party pages were used during interactive verification.
Research prototypes, limited-partner robotics access, and generally available API models must remain distinct.
Project release notes establish software changes and dates; performance implications vary by workload and hardware.
